seo.title: Press, contact and press kit | Awrea Paris
seo.description: Awrea Paris for the press: the Maison’s contact for journalists, stylists and requests for an interview with the designer.

chapeau: Journalists, stylists, requests for an interview with the designer: the Maison answers every request by email.

contact.texte: For an interview with the designer or a question about the Hypnotic Lace collection, write to the Maison and tell us the publication and the date it will appear.

kit.texte: The Maison’s logo and the Awrea Paris presentation text are sent on request, to the same address.
